key_insight: An LLM-driven closed loop discovers interpretable bioprocess dynamics by sequentially isolating entangled kinetic effects and expanding the modeled state space.
engineering_relevance: The approach could improve digital twins for continuous biomanufacturing when missing kinetic mechanisms limit model fidelity.
method: Ground an LLM agent in a two-level retrieval-augmented knowledge library.
Combine moving horizon estimation, logarithmic decomposition, and isolation-peeling across operating regimes to separate kinetic effects.
Trigger targeted experimental perturbations when competing model hypotheses remain statistically indistinguishable.
evidence_signal: In a continuous stirred-tank reactor evaluation with unmodeled Haldane inhibition, Luong product toxicity, and secondary metabolite autocatalysis, the framework recovered ground-truth parameters with under 6% error.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness on real biomanufacturing data, where noise and safety constraints may limit informative perturbations.
paper_title: Autonomous Structural Discovery Of Bioprocess Dynamics And Kinetics Via LLM-Driven Agents
